features.description: internal/mission: TOML registry schema + loader + validation, one file per mission in missions/ (HD-1a). No [roles] block — the loader must REJECT one.
acceptance_criteria: Loads a valid entry and round-trips every field
Rejects a [roles] key, naming M-MODEL-REGISTRY-SINGLE-SOURCE as the owner, so the scope cut cannot silently regress
Rejects unknown schedule mode, absent workdir, and a boot_offset colliding with another registered mission
Load() over the real missions/ dir is deterministic and order-independent
Every validation error names the file and the field
features.notes: 90.2% coverage. Mutation-tested: 3 mutants killed. Caught and fixed a vacuous sort assertion (asserted on Names(), which sorts internally).

features.description: Render env + plist to *.staged only. Role/model lines carried through VERBATIM from the live env (ratified; M8 parked). Includes the atomic-write helper V15 found absent. Plist rendering is new code, not an extension of the daemon template (V17).
acceptance_criteria: GOLDEN: rendering each of the four current missions is byte-identical to what is installed today, except the schedule block
A live env role line unknown to the registry still renders unchanged
keepalive renders KeepAlive+ThrottleInterval; interval renders StartInterval; never both
Rendered plists pass plutil -lint
Every rendered PATH contains /usr/sbin, enforcing the V8 regression at render time
Writes only *.staged — a test asserts no non-staged path is opened for write
features.notes: Golden: docs/motoko/world byte-identical to installed. v1 is the implicit mission (comments-only env, driver defaults) and is asserted, not skipped. 5 mutants killed. 85.7% coverage.

features.description: ailang mission doctor + list: registry-vs-installed drift, driver resolution, pin status, PATH reachability of sysctl. Replaces the hand-maintained comment table at mission-control.sh:752. THIS IS THE SPRINT GATE.
acceptance_criteria: GATE: reproduces V4 (docs 4-line / world 65-line env drift) on the live rig
GATE: reproduces V5 (repo copy routes to codex, installed routes to opus fail-closed)
GATE: reproduces V8 (v1/docs plist PATH omits /usr/sbin, disabling the boot stagger)
Reports world as a fork with no pin; v1/docs/motoko as pin-backed
Read-only: a test asserts no write to ~/.config or ~/Library/LaunchAgents
Exit codes 0 clean / 1 drift / 2 registry error
features.notes: GATE MET on the live rig: V4/V5 (docs names MISSION_PLANNER_ALLOWLIST), V8 (v1+docs), world no-pin+fork. Running the gate exposed that registry-vs-installed cannot see V5; added installed-vs-reviewed. 7 mutants killed, 87.3% coverage.

features.description: cmd/ailang/mission.go following messages_send.go conventions; four registry entries authored FROM INSTALLED STATE (not the repo copies, which are what drifted); make test-mission-registry wired into CI.
acceptance_criteria: ailang mission list and doctor work end-to-end against the real fleet
Four registry entries exist and load
New make target runs in CI and the orphan-suite check still passes
make test and make test-launchd-drivers both green
features.notes: list/doctor/install work end-to-end. 4 entries from installed state, carrying the rationale the plists cannot. make test + test-launchd-drivers + test-mission-registry all exit 0.

features.description: ailang mission apply: HD-3(c) refuse first adoption without --adopt, HD-4(b) refuse on a live pidfile (--force escape hatch), promote both staged files by atomic rename, then a launchd reload where EVERY wait is bounded.
acceptance_criteria: Refuses while the mission holds a live pidfile; --force overrides (HD-4b)
Refuses a first adoption without --adopt, printing what would change (HD-3c)
Promotes both artifacts by atomic rename, or neither
bootout 10s / bootstrap 10s / verify 15s, each a typed timeout error; worst case bounded at 35s
A failed bootstrap retains the staged copies for a re-apply
launchctl is injected, so the bounded-wait logic is tested without booting out a live job
features.notes: 11 mutants, 1 survived (promotion order untested) and was fixed. Bounded 35s worst case. launchctl injected.

features.description: Reconcile the remaining divergences deliberately under HD-3(c) and bring all four missions under generated artifacts. Includes fixing V8 for real (the v1/docs plist PATH) rather than relying on the driver-side mitigation.
acceptance_criteria: Every mission's installed plist carries the generated marker
ailang mission doctor exits 0 on the live fleet
V8 is fixed at source: no installed plist sets a PATH lacking /usr/sbin
No mission is reloaded while mid-iteration
The pre-adoption artifacts are backed up and the backup path is reported
features.notes: All 4 adopted. Diffing before apply caught 2 fleet-damaging bugs (launchd log collision, pin clobber); using the tool caught a 3rd (--no-reload refused on busy). V8 fixed at source on all 4 plists. Doctor now reports only world fork/no-pin (Phase 3).

features.description: Delete the reach truth-table comment at mission-control.sh:752 and the _mc_boot_offset case arm, now that both are computed from the registry. Adding a surface without removing one is the failure mode the design names.
acceptance_criteria: The comment table is gone and replaced by a pointer to `ailang mission list`
Boot offsets come from the registry, with the case arm removed or reduced to a fallback
make test-launchd-drivers still exit 0
A test asserts the table cannot silently return
features.notes: Table deleted, replaced by a pointer to the computed one. Two guards, both proven non-vacuous. Boot offsets stay in bash but the registry is authoritative and divergence is caught.

features.description: Close the blind spot Phase 2 created: doctor compares the registry against the installed FILE, not against launchd's LOADED job, so v1 passes clean while running pre-adoption config. Add a loaded-vs-file check via launchctl print.
acceptance_criteria: Reports when launchd's loaded config disagrees with the installed plist
Reproduces it on v1 RIGHT NOW (promoted with --no-reload, so loaded is pre-adoption)
Names the disagreeing key, not just 'differs'
Does not fire on the three missions whose loaded config matches
launchctl is injected so the check is testable without a live domain
Stays read-only
features.notes: Caught v1 loaded-stale on the live fleet; 3 matching missions not flagged. 6 mutants, 1 survived (severity unasserted) and fixed.

features.description: Render passthrough from tools/launchd/mission-env/<name>.env (the reviewed copy) rather than from the installed one, so reviewed-vs-installed drift becomes impossible after an apply and the repo copy regains its meaning as the thing you edit.
acceptance_criteria: Passthrough is read from the reviewed copy when one exists, else the installed one
After an apply, installed == reviewed by construction; doctor cannot report env-source-drift
Editing the reviewed copy and running install/apply deploys the edit — the V5 workflow, fixed
Golden tests still prove byte-identity for the current fleet
features.notes: Proven E2E on the live fleet with a probe line. 3 mutants killed.
